help.short: The name of the diagnostic setting.

description: Get the active diagnostic setting for AadIam.

operations.description: Gets the active diagnostic setting for AadIam.

params.description: The name of the diagnostic setting.
params.name: name

props.description: Properties of a Diagnostic Settings Resource.
props.name: properties

props.description: The resource Id for the event hub authorization rule.
props.name: eventHubAuthorizationRuleId

props.description: The name of the event hub. If none is specified, the default event hub will be selected.
props.name: eventHubName

props.description: Name of a Diagnostic Log category for a resource type this setting is applied to. To obtain the list of Diagnostic Log categories for a resource, first perform a GET diagnostic settings operation.
props.name: category

props.description: A value indicating whether this log is enabled.
props.name: enabled

props.description: The retention policy for this log.
props.name: retentionPolicy

props.description: The number of days for the retention in days. A value of 0 will retain the events indefinitely.
props.name: days

props.description: A value indicating whether the retention policy is enabled.
props.name: enabled

props.description: The service bus rule Id of the diagnostic setting. This is here to maintain backwards compatibility.
props.name: serviceBusRuleId

props.description: The resource ID of the storage account to which you would like to send Diagnostic Logs.
props.name: storageAccountId

props.description: The workspace ID (resource ID of a Log Analytics workspace) for a Log Analytics workspace to which you would like to send Diagnostic Logs. Example: /subscriptions/4b9e8510-67ab-4e9a-95a9-e2f1e570ea9c/resourceGroups/insights-integration/providers/Microsoft.OperationalInsights/workspaces/viruela2
props.name: workspaceId

responses.description: Successful request to get more information about diagnostic setting
Error. Request for AadIam diagnostic setting has failed.
